reviews.text: Class schedule on the website is wrong half the time. Showed up for 7am sunrise flow, no class.
Gorgeous deck, inspiring teacher. Best yoga I've done anywhere in the Caribbean, hands down.
No way to pay online for drop-ins, they only take exact cash at the door.
The owner replied to my message the same day and moved my private session. Easy.
Couldn't figure out where the studio actually is. Address on Insta ([handle]) just says 'Lorient hill'. Drove around for 20 min.
Teacher only explains in French, I missed half the cues. Pretty but frustrating.

reviews.evidence: Online timetable unreliable; an early session listed there did not happen.
Inspiring instructor and setting, rated the finest in the region.
Single classes cannot be paid digitally; exact change needed on site.
Location given online is vague; reviewer spent a long time searching.
Instructions given in one language only, hard for a non-speaker to follow.
